# Roughtime verification fixtures

The three `appendix-b-original-*` files are the first request, response, and
public root vector published in [RFC 10049 Appendix B](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc10049.html#appendix-B).
The three `erratum-9238-proposal-*` files are the corresponding proposed
replacement from [RFC Editor erratum 9238](https://errata.rfc-editor.org/eid9238/).
The same notice applies to these six IETF test vector files.

The accompanying keys are public fixture verification keys.
